scientific_question: Can the supported global P and direct-local L organization retain generic competence, the registered causal links, and the frozen Liu behavior profile after removing historical input/output ABI channels, shortening every trial, and exactly packing the antisymmetric local state?
hypothesis: Bias, normalized time, legacy reward, previous-action channels, a value head, two choice logits, two opposed modulation units, blank pre-roll, and the redundant half of the antisymmetric local tensor are not required for the supported P/L computation.

claim_boundary.candidate: This is a new development candidate. It does not rewrite or supersede any frozen checkpoint, study, result, or reporting claim unless it later passes the complete registered development and confirmation program.
claim_boundary.retained_theory: The candidate retains a cue-addressed recurrent fast-weight state P for global relational assembly, a direct cue-pair trace L for experienced-relation fidelity, differential global/local evidence admission, and staged outer-loop fitting.
claim_boundary.not_tested: The study does not test a scalar replacement for P, autonomous emergence of two stores, arbitrary-domain transport, human neural implementation, or the separate diminishing-plasticity learner.
claim_boundary.development_scope: Seeds 2801--2803 are development networks. They are not a network-population sample and cannot establish confirmation by themselves.
claim_boundary.confirmation_scope: Seeds 2804--2806 are prospectively reserved unchanged confirmation networks and are executed only if every development admission gate passes without repair or tuning.
claim_boundary.human_scope: The Liu task, temperature, human reference intervals, and behavior definitions are inherited project-exposed evidence; fresh network seeds are not fresh human confirmation.

parent_evidence.carried_positive: The maintained P/L model is competent; P supports remote/global assembly, L supports direct experienced-relation fidelity, and differential evidence admission rescues omitted direct evidence. Six of nine frozen behavior rows are quantitative matches and all nine have registered qualitative classifications.
parent_evidence.carried_negative: Registered scalar/global reductions do not close P dynamics, and matched joint training failed the registered noninferiority rule. The candidate therefore preserves the recurrent P state and the global-then-local optimization schedule.

seeds.selection: Six consecutive unused seeds selected before implementation. Exact seed-label search found no registered or runtime training use before registration.

task.query_pairs: All 28 unordered pairs with randomized left/right orientation and order.
task.information_boundary: Only ordinary left/right item cues, the displayed support magnitude after global admission, and a response-phase pulse enter the recurrent model. No relation identity, true rank, target, learned/omitted flag, posterior, diagnostic label, or evaluation outcome enters training rollout.
task.holdouts: Exclude the registered Liu v1/v2 graph signatures and reflections from generic training and use the existing reflection-canonical graph bucket zero only for generic validation.

architecture.name: compact P/L recurrent learner

input_layout.31: signed globally admitted support evidence; zero on queries

removed_inputs: explicit constant-bias channel; the input linear layer retains its learned bias
architecture.state_reset: Reset hidden and eligibility at the start of every support and query trial; preserve P across support trials; reset P and L between episodes.
architecture.step_zero: Present both cues and support evidence. Queries use zero evidence.
architecture.step_one: Present only the response-phase pulse. Read the query margin here. On support trials this step applies the modulation computed from the step-one hidden state to the eligibility formed at step zero.
architecture.global_recurrence: h_t=tanh(W_in x_t+b_in + [W + alpha elementwise P_t] h_(t-1)).
architecture.global_modulation: m_t=scale*tanh(w_m h_t+b_m), with one scalar modulation unit and one learned scalar scale.
architecture.global_update: P_(t+1)=clip(P_t + m_t E_t,-50,50); E_(t+1)=(1-eta_E)E_t+eta_E*tanh(h_t h_(t-1)^T). Preserve this numerical update order.
architecture.global_readout: One learned scalar margin g_q=w_o h_response+b_o; positive means the left item ranks higher. There is no value head and no two-logit choice head.
architecture.local_key: Let A=c_left c_right^T-c_right c_left^T. Pack the 105 strict upper-triangle entries and divide by their Euclidean norm. This packed key has exactly the same pairwise inner products as the normalized 225-entry antisymmetric key.
architecture.local_write: L_(t+1)=L_t+s_L*k_t, one write per support presentation.
architecture.local_read: ell_q=dot(L_T,k_q), lambda_L=softplus(raw_gain), and final margin M_q=g_q+lambda_L*ell_q.
architecture.query_policy: Every query reads the same terminal P_T and L_T. Proposed query updates are discarded.

optimization.optimizer: Adam; betas=(0.9,0.999), eps=1e-8, weight_decay=0, amsgrad=false; no scheduler
optimization.global_phase: Steps 0--999 disable the local correction exactly and optimize the complete compact recurrent backbone using mean softplus(-y*g) plus 1e-4*mean(P_T^2).
optimization.local_phase: Steps 1000--1499 freeze every backbone tensor, activate the final differential-admission local trace, and optimize only raw_gain using mean softplus(-y*M).
optimization.selection: Use the final step only. No intermediate checkpoint selection, early stopping, learning-rate change, extra step, gain refit, temperature refit, or seed replacement.

implementation_gates.input: Verify exact width and channel isolation; changing removed channels is impossible because they are absent.
implementation_gates.packed_local_equivalence: For deterministic forward/reverse/random cue fixtures, packed writes and reads must match the existing full antisymmetric trace within atol=1e-6 and reversal must negate the key.
implementation_gates.margin_equivalence: For deterministic fixtures, binary cross-entropy from symmetric logits [-M/2,M/2] must equal softplus(-y*M) within atol=1e-7.
implementation_gates.state_integrity: Verify no blank pre-roll, exactly two recurrent steps per trial, support-only P/L retention, discarded query writes, and exact reset between episodes.
implementation_gates.gradients: Generic query loss must yield finite nonzero gradients through terminal P to support-time parameters and through lambda_L in the local phase. Verify exact backbone freeze in the local phase.
implementation_gates.eager_compile_parity: On seed 920001 non-Liu fixtures, compare eager and fullgraph CUDA margins, loss, gradients, and one Adam update using atol=1e-5 and rtol=1e-4.
implementation_gates.failure: Any failed correctness, gradient, source, or runtime gate blocks scientific training. An implementation-only correction is append-only and requires complete requalification before a replacement source lock.

execution.device: CUDA required for registered training and neural evaluation; CPU is sufficient for algebraic qualification.
execution.precision: float32 neural computation without autocast or TF32; float64 summaries
execution.artifact_policy: Training checkpoints and dense replay arrays are transient ignored runtime artifacts. Keep them until their source/configuration/RNG identities, hashes, qualification, evaluation, and canonical JSON/Markdown reports are independently verified. Then remove the transient binaries; reproducibility is by locked recipe and retraining, not by retaining every checkpoint.
execution.interruption: Never resume an unverified partial artifact. A technical replay restarts from initialization under the same seed and locked contract in a separately identified attempt.

generic_evaluation.competence: For every network independently, intact learned exact-decision mean must be at least 0.75 and intact nonlearned exact-decision mean at least 0.70.
generic_evaluation.local_partition: P_off learned exact-decision mean must exceed 0.50 and P_off nonlearned exact-decision mean must not exceed 0.55.

liu_evaluation.cohort_identity: Reuse the frozen v2.4 Liu cohort construction and seeds so architecture is the only changed scientific factor; do not refit temperature or human references.
liu_evaluation.required_diagnostics: Retain write_off, alpha_zero, reset, shuffle, query-order invariance, all-relation leave-one-out remote influence, Hodge field metrics, and every frozen nine-row behavior endpoint.

decision_contract.prerequisites: Source/artifact/input integrity, implementation gates, finite optimization, and generic competence pass for every mandatory network.
decision_contract.liu_competence: For every network, intact overall exact-decision mean must be at least 0.75, intact nonlearned mean at least 0.70, and transitive-triplet mean at least 0.95.
decision_contract.global_necessity: Intact-minus-P_off nonlearned correct-probability lower bound is at least 0.10 and P_off nonlearned upper bound is at most 0.55.
decision_contract.remote_reassembly: Own-global all-relation remote-absolute lower bound exceeds 0.01 raw-margin units and third-party-relational lower bound exceeds 0.05.
decision_contract.direct_local_fidelity: Intact-minus-local_off correct-probability lower bound is at least 0.01 separately for retained and omitted learned pairs.
decision_contract.address_specificity: Intact-minus-query_shuffle and intact-minus-evidence_shuffle learned correct-probability lower bounds are each at least 0.01.
decision_contract.local_only_partition: P_off learned correct-probability lower bound exceeds 0.50, P_off nonlearned upper bound is at most 0.55, and the upper bound of local-only remote minus 0.25 times intact combined remote is at most zero.
decision_contract.behavior: All nine inherited qualitative rules pass and the six historically quantitative rows retain their reproduced classification independently in every network. Distance slope, serial endpoints, and self-inconsistency remain mandatory reports and may improve; no mismatch is hidden.
decision_contract.development_admission: All prerequisites, competence, five causal-link families, local-only partition, and behavior preservation pass independently in all three development seeds.
decision_contract.confirmation: If and only if development admission passes, execute the unchanged implementation on seeds 2804--2806. Promotion requires every development gate to pass independently again in all three confirmation seeds.
decision_contract.heterogeneity: No pooling, majority vote, seed filtering, or successful network repairs a failed all-seed gate.

outcomes.compact_model_confirmed: Every gate passes in development and unchanged confirmation seeds.
outcomes.development_candidate_only: Every development gate passes but one or more confirmation gates fail.
outcomes.competent_alternative_organization: Competence passes but one or more causal-organization gates fail.
outcomes.behavior_incomplete: Competence and causal organization pass but behavior preservation fails.
outcomes.compact_model_rejected: Integrity-valid development training fails competence or multiple mandatory preservation gates.
outcomes.noninterpretable: A source, artifact, input, implementation, optimization-finiteness, or mandatory execution gate fails.

cleanup_gate.new_runtime: After confirmed canonical reports pass independent reconstruction, delete transient compact-model checkpoints and dense replay arrays while retaining the immutable protocol, locks, source/config/RNG identities, hashes, canonical JSON result, and concise Markdown report.
cleanup_gate.historical_checkpoints: Do not delete historical tracked checkpoints during development. Only compact_model_confirmed authorizes a separate exact retention migration that inventories each old binary, verifies its frozen study/report coverage and Git recoverability, updates active locators append-only, and removes only binaries whose unique scientific content is represented in canonical reports.
cleanup_gate.failure: Any non-confirmed outcome preserves the historical P/L checkpoint set unchanged.

lifecycle: Commit this native contract and registry entry before implementation or seed execution.
Implement the compact model and focused tests without scientific-seed outcomes; pass CPU qualification and CUDA eager/compile parity.
Commit the implementation and qualification, then write and commit a source lock over the exact protocol and implementation before development training.
Train all three development seeds to the final step and jointly lock checkpoints, configurations, logs, stream identities, and tensor hashes before any Liu evaluation.
Evaluate generic and Liu gates, publish the complete per-seed development report, and stop without tuning if development admission fails.
Only after complete development admission, train and jointly lock confirmation seeds 2804--2806 under the unchanged source and protocol, then evaluate the same gates.
Publish canonical machine-readable and human reports with positive, negative, and unresolved findings; validate the registered study and workflow boundary.
Only after compact_model_confirmed, execute a separately reviewed append-only checkpoint-retention migration and leave the active tree report-oriented.
stop_rule: Do not repair an exposed scientific result by changing channels, hidden size, trial steps, modulation equation, P/L state, evidence admission, optimizer, budget, thresholds, temperature, seeds, cohorts, or behavior definitions. A failed candidate remains registered evidence; a different simplification is a new prospectively registered study.
